_meta.project: instex Instrument Explorer -- TELESCOPES mode: Vera C. Rubin Observatory Simonyi Survey Telescope, the LSSTCam focus and the entrance pupil
_meta.companion: data/telescopes/rubin.md (same content as Markdown). Structure follows elt.json: sources{key: cite, file, url}; rubin: title, telescope (machine-readable mirrors, camera, pupil and focus; refs point to params as rubin.<param>), explorer_preset (the proposed web/tpresets.js entry, not applied), params, not_found, conflicts, notes.
_meta.rule: Each value carries src (key into sources), loc and a short verbatim quote from a document saved unmodified under rawdata/telescopes/rubin/. derived = arithmetic done here (shown). alternatives = other sourced values. figure_readoff = a value read off a saved figure (nearby text is the checked quote). INFERRED = reasoned, stated by no source. NOT FOUND marks a gap. Nothing is filled from memory.
_meta.quote_normalization: Unicode NFKC; curly quotes, primes, dashes, minus, multiplication sign, tilde operator, approximately-equal sign, inequality signs, micro sign and degree glyphs normalized; whitespace collapsed; a quote also passes with PDF line-end hyphenation removed or closed up, or with all whitespace (and hyphens) removed; ' ... ' joins non-adjacent pieces.
_meta.texts_checked: pdftotext -layout, -raw and default for PDFs; HTML tag-stripped (comments removed; tags to a space and tags removed) and raw source; .yaml and .py as is.
_meta.pupil_frame: imSim pupil-plane frame (bars at 45 and 135 deg); orientation relative to the elevation axis NOT FOUND

explorer_preset.name: Rubin (Simonyi) 8.4 m
explorer_preset.primaryNote: M1 and M3 share one 8.4 m monolith of Ohara E6 glass. M1 is the outer annulus, 8.36 m clear outside and 5.12 m inside, with a radius of curvature of 19.835 m (f = 9.92 m, f/1.19); the 5.0 m M3 fills the center (radius of curvature 8.34 m), with the M3 vertex 0.23 m below M1's. A hole through the center of M3 (1.06 m across in a 2006 drawing) holds alignment equipment.
explorer_preset.pupilNote: An annulus 8.36 m across with a 5.12 m hole (M3 fills the center of the glass), crossed by eight 50 mm vanes in four parallel pairs 0.8 m apart, which hold M2 and the camera (imSim's model; the Science Book puts the vanes' area at ~0.7 m²). The orientation relative to the elevation axis is not published; the camera rotates between exposures, so the spikes turn on the sky.

spider.figure_readoff: K06 pupil image (2006): an annulus crossed by four pairs of parallel vanes, the pairs vertical above and below and horizontal left and right of the hole, the bars of each pair 55-56 px apart on a 579 px outer diameter, i.e. 0.80 m apart and 0.40 m from the center for 8.4 m (0.40 m for 8.36 m); the hole of that model spans 332 px (4.8 m).
spider.derived: imSim: |n.p - d| < 0.025 m, so each bar is 0.05 m wide (K06: 50 mm), at +/-0.4 m from the center along the 45 and 135 deg normals. Each bar crosses the M1 annulus twice: 2 (sqrt(4.18^2 - 0.4^2) - sqrt(2.558^2 - 0.4^2)) = 3.269 m; four bars x 3.269 m x 0.05 m = 0.654 m^2 (SB09 ~0.7 m^2). The bars cross one another 0.566 m from the center, inside the obstruction.
